text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with 14 field reps for one quarter. Here's what actually happened.

The wins:
→ Reps reclaimed about 5 hours a week of post-call admin
→ CRM updates went from "eventually" to same-day
→ Managers coached from real conversations, not recaps

The surprises:
→ Customers asked about recording far less than we feared, but only when reps disclosed upfront
→ Summaries missed nuance on pricing objections, so reps still review before saving
→ Adoption tracked with manager habits, not training sessions

The takeaway: the tool didn't make reps better sellers. It gave them time and visibility to improve themselves.

If you're piloting one, start with disclosure scripts and a review step.

What did your team learn?
